description: This course introduces the fundamental concepts and techniques in combinatorics and graph theory, with an eye towards applications in computer science, engineering and operations research. For combinatorics, the course will cover basic counting principles, distribution problems, binomial theorem, generating functions and recurrence relations. Topics from graph theory include basic concepts and results, paths and cycles, connectivity, bipartite graphs and trees.
